answer_4.quote: We sampled 553 images, each one with an original and perturbed QA pair for a total of 1,106 instances... The (image, question) pairs were answered independently by human annotators on Amazon Mechanical Turk... We found that the workers were able to correctly answer 72.3% of the perturbed questions, slightly lower than their performance on the original questions (76.6%).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to answer each original and perturbed question and their responses were compared to the ground‑truth answers.
